observed_query_concurrency.note: A group shares the image and question but has separate measured object regions. Multiple condition questions do not prove simultaneous remote transports or equal accuracy after batching. Raw attempts, not logical episode count.

censored_specialized_service.definition: Each actually completed route provides a fixed motion duration evaluated against the archival query clocks. No simultaneous paired camera/service measurement is inferred. A cutoff supplies only a lower bound on time to a hypothetical valid reply, which can be infinite. No missing judgment is imputed.
censored_specialized_service.break_even: Illustrative risk-neutral one-trip model: if a later on-demand trip costs the same duration d, and a useful early capture eliminates that trip, expected time advantage equals p*d minus mean uncovered motion. The probability interval is the range of thresholds allowed by censoring, not a measured activation rate. Excludes recognition, route changes and task success.

real_offer_planners.interpretation: Frozen real pre-request camera candidates and costs. The full factored and generic algorithms use identical legal subsets and priors. At this point an in-flight image request cannot accept additional photos, so strong physical prefetch can enumerate the same feasible acquisitions. The oracle regret uses nominal trip costs and the subsequently realized model choice, never task time.

frozen_ranker_relative_order.scope: retrospective relative ordering on capacity-one identity trips, including the first slot of two-capacity policies
frozen_ranker_relative_order.interpretation: The old linear predictors were trained for synthetic branch success or deadline-restricted gain. On these comparable one-trip offers the other nine coordinates are common to the two candidates; their exact differences can be scored without inventing the unobserved open-row task size or a service deadline. Ranking can only pick by duration here. A raw GPT request for a photo is a demand label, not a verified advantage or final task benefit. Retrieval models and larger mixed-coverage prefixes are outside this result.

cross_fitted_demand_action_changes.interpretation: Offline single frozen decision. Exact legal subsets and nominal round-trip estimates are identical for all four variants. Only probabilities differ. The later real response and observed transport window score choices after selection. Unseen travel times and later ordinary model replies are never synthesized. Section estimates do not establish a complete-task improvement.

observed_approach_refusals.note: A normal decision is matched to its execution record. Segmented-navigation calls with the same frame id are separate and cannot replace the original action. A later ordinary response can incorporate a fresh camera or additional evidence even after rejection; its service time cannot all be credited to an unobserved alternative. Original map and target-grounding refusals remain intact.

measured_condition_range.interpretation: A scoped numerical range packet can show actual physical surfaces. Correct branch inference is untested, an absent hit does not establish a clear portal, and these fresh resets do not supply the old run's missing range scan.

matched_room_same_source_break_even.formula: For the observed branch front-negative and side-positive, both views fixed and finish at side: front-first costs max(s,t)+2s; side-first costs t+s+b. Terms are equal singleton s, actual side transit with capture t, and paired request b. Numeric calibration implies b>s; side-first wins for t<2s-b. Field outcomes were unavailable to the controller; this is path-specific and excludes startup, controller overhead and timeout.
matched_room_same_source_break_even.reliability: If independent caller-level failure rates are h1 for a single and h2 for a grouped call, this particular two-call plan is more likely to deliver than three singles when h2 < 1-(1-h1)^2. No failure probabilities are inferred from the two exact-input timeout pairs.

native_semantic_frontier.criterion: Only genuine in-input source hashes and correctly typed primary predicates are counted; counting a later observed fact is not proof the same answer was obtainable earlier. Candidate-only durations cannot be counted as task savings. Exact source-claim triples repeated in a later report count once per trajectory. No simulator labels or extra requests.

deadline_sensitive_workflow.note: All costs and probabilities are model-based sensitivity results. The two timeout rates for a two-question one-image call are not estimates from an adequate sample. Previously measured motion at a specific site is available on revisits only.

ordinary_section_proposals.scope: Supplied source, ordinary action, task proposal and field grammar only; independent visual correctness and complete task delivery require new physical episodes.

house_56_order_cost_envelope.scope: Exact first-decision sensitivity with optimal cost-aware recourse. 'Collect then choose' assumes the cost profile can be resolved at that checkpoint; a real capture by itself reveals no semantic-service latency. The true robust attainable cost can be higher. cross_source_service_transfer.scope: Calibration-only. Matched already-completed responses stand in for choices to expose transfer risk. native_discovered_schedule_replay.caveat: Fixed original reply and actual source/clock receipts. Group latency ratios and unseen gate routes are sensitivity inputs. The actual native position at dispatch is not replaced; this is a policy replay without new actions or semantic outcomes.

dynamic_permission_reuse_ablation.note: Timing repetitions use the same topology and price scenarios as the prior development benchmark. Four arms all retain legal options, evaluate revised prices and use the same recursive search and legal actions.

fixed_transport_critical_path.comparison: Frozen realized prompts, replies and service times in the two scored cohorts. With serial sends, their union is a lower bound even if all motion and local work vanish. Removing or regrouping requests can change both outputs and service. Do not extrapolate the bound to a changed controller.
fixed_transport_critical_path.route_scope: One frozen ordinary call. For available options use the real returned demand after dispatch; this is an oracle diagnostic. Observed route time includes acquisition and verified return. An untraveled demanded alternative has unknown cost, at most one service window can be hidden. The separate nominal table uses pre-request trip estimates for unrealized routes. These are not whole-task effects.

same_photo_claim_comparison.interpretation: Selected actual multi-object citations matched to specialized queries, not a controlled joint/single comparison. Ordinary replies may see earlier material, memory and additional photographs. No timing or one-image accuracy effect can be attributed to batching from these samples.

observed_camera_interface.note: Terminal enhanced episodes only. A nested valid id identifies an unrecognized expression of demand, not an actual release. On a retry, logical-step physical events are counted once on its terminal attempt; photo_chains separately checks actual transport overlap. Accepted camera requests and independently grounded downstream uses are different events.

public_roster_on_fresh_camera.note: Initial onboard RGBs stored during the eight completed navigation resets. Candidate geometry requires a later live map check. No semantic answers, model-latency observations or full task success are claimed.
